verdict.rationale: ZCode presents itself as an AI coding workbench with desktop, browser and terminal-agent surfaces (zcode-gh-1). Its marketing claims multi-agent collaboration, Goal-based management of complex work, and support for 20+ coding tools including Claude Code (zcode-docs-1, zcode-docs-2, zcode-docs-5), while community users compare it to Codex and Conductor-style workspaces (zcode-comm-3, zcode-comm-11). However, no documentation explicitly shows a unified view for listing, switching between or supervising multiple concurrent agent sessions. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multi-session management (parallel sessions, session list or switching, oversight dashboard), and hands-on corroboration of running and managing several agent sessions side by side.
